name: Unit-Tests
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - dev

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: selenium/node-chrome:latest
      # use root due to installing stuff and more
      options: --user root
      env:
        CHROME_BIN: /opt/google/chrome/chrome
        INSIDE_DOCKER: 1
        NVM_DIR: /usr/local/nvm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
